reviews.title: My "Go To' Ram
reviews.comment:
Update 2026:  Still running like a dream.  Have had it on the AMD Expo 1 setting (stability) Expo 2 being manufacturers max specs)) this entire time and not a hiccup to be mentioned.  Have dabbled with a lot of the latest games out (BF6, Crimson Desert, etc) and minimal loads time, superb performance.  Definitely a winner, but the price I'm seeing for these modules now is nothing short of greedy and evil.
Been running this RAM for about a year now and have zero complaints.  Has performed flawlessly and at the intended / advertised speeds.  Very pleased.  Great quality all around.  As a long time Patriot, Mushkin and a little corsair, I am now adding Acer to my personally certified list of "Go To" sticks.
I'm running 2x 32gb modules with the AMD 7800X3D, PowerColor Red Devil AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT,  ROG Strix B650E-F Mobo and a couple of Samsung 990 PRO 2tb SSD's.  Had zero issues, always performs at peak speeds, never get hot (though I have ample air flow in the SSUPD Xhuttle case) and they look great.
Superior memory quality all around.  Will be adding to the next build in a couple months.
Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great, with some Q&A opportunities
reviews.comment: I bought these at the right time, now, they are no longer available in 64, so this is great. Overall they are great, they support xmp as expo. My only complaint would be quality, the heat shield where barely on and would come off easily, but nothing that could not be fixed with a little press and they were good to go.

reviews.title: Excellent value ram solid build quality
reviews.comment: Looks great, nice build quality worked off the bat with my 7900X. Definitely better quality than other ram kits i tried in the past. Will use again … lifetime warranty … hoping it’s just as good incase my kit goes bad. 64gb for 229.99 great value.a little tall due to the rgb but works seemsly.
